name: Loops and reminders
summary: Repeat a prompt on a schedule or set a reminder while your session is open.
what: The /loop command reruns a prompt at a fixed interval or at a pace Claude picks, which is handy for watching a deploy or a pull request. You can also ask for one-off reminders in plain words. These tasks only run while Claude Code is open and idle.

impact.title: Hands-off polling
impact.detail: Check a build or deploy without asking again and again.

impact.title: Reminders in plain words
impact.detail: Ask Claude to remind you at a time and it will.

impact.title: Bounded
impact.detail: Recurring tasks end on their own after a set time.

howItWorks: Run /loop 5m <prompt> to repeat every five minutes (s, m, h or d).
Run /loop <prompt> without an interval and Claude chooses the delay.
Ask in plain words for a reminder, such as at 3pm.
Press Esc, or ask Claude, to stop a loop.
For tasks that must run while your computer is off, use cloud scheduled tasks.

events.note: Added the /loop command to rerun a prompt on an interval.
